_comment: SG-1. The strategy fields as a FRAGMENT, spread over scene-valid.json — the same shape scene-staging.json uses, so each refusal below differs from a passing scene by exactly one field.

character_beats.performs: He declines to energize a circuit whose condition is unknown, and states the condition on which he would act.
character_beats.derivedFrom: Canon: Rami's want — 'without pressure to energize a circuit whose condition is unknown' — and 'Rami defines what may be safely energized.'

character_beats.performs: Bedside teams begin manual support and Rami isolates the board under existing authority, without the participant.
character_beats.occurs_when: The participant delays or chooses an unsafe coordination approach.
character_beats.derivedFrom: Canon, the fail-forward rule: 'bedside clinical teams begin manual support and Rami isolates the board under existing authority.'
